digest.component_or_area: capability registry and optional dependency enforcement
propositions: A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must validate that every capability references a declared packaging extra, every route's capability name exists, and no probe imports the optional package.
Stable verbs and top-level help must remain present in a no-extras wheel; only selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection emit actionable errors for error postures.
Lean diagnostic paths (audit show, non-agent workflows, dry-run modes) must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities.
Domain components retain control of result payloads and logging for unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures; the registry never manufactures their domain result.
Separate entrypoints mcp_server and review_bot must be registry capabilities but not appear in the CLI route registry.
